ValidationRule.description: Prevents closing an Opportunity as Closed Won if the related Account does not have a Billing Address.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( ISBLANK(Account.BillingStreet), ISBLANK(Account.BillingCity), ISBLANK(Account.BillingCountry) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot mark Opportunity as Closed Won. Please complete the Account Billing Address first.
